subject: sentences
title: Naming, action, describing
about: Nouns (naming words), verbs (action words) and adjectives (describing words), the three word jobs CKLA teaches across Units 1 to 4. Each card shows three words and asks which one does a given job.
tip: Say the test out loud with him: can you touch it (naming), can you do it (action), does it tell what something is like (describing)?

cards.q: Which word is a naming word?
cards.note: A cup is a thing. A naming word names a person, place or thing (CKLA calls it a noun).

cards.q: Which word is a naming word?
cards.note: A dog is a thing you can touch. A naming word names a person, place or thing (CKLA calls it a noun).

cards.q: Which word is a naming word?
cards.note: A bed is a thing. A naming word names a person, place or thing (CKLA calls it a noun).

cards.q: Which word is a naming word?
cards.note: A hill is a place. A naming word names a person, place or thing (CKLA calls it a noun).

cards.q: Which word is a naming word?
cards.note: Sam is a person, so his name is a naming word too. A naming word names a person, place or thing (CKLA calls it a noun).

cards.q: Which word is an action word?
cards.note: You can jump. An action word tells what someone does (a verb).

cards.q: Which word is an action word?
cards.note: You can swim. An action word tells what someone does (a verb).

cards.q: Which word is an action word?

cards.q: Which word is a describing word?
cards.note: Big tells size. A describing word tells size, color or how it feels (an adjective).

cards.q: Which word is a describing word?
